name: Pole of Angling

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: A 10-ft pole that becomes a fishing pole.
text: While holding this 10-foot pole, you can speak a command word and transform it into a fishing pole with a hook, a line and a reel. Speaking another command word changes the fishing pole back into a normal 10-foot pole. (No other effect in the game.)
